create_OLMOConfig: create an OLMOConfig dataclass instance to configure an OLMO2 or OLMO3 model architecture
create_YaRNScaleConfig: create a YaRNScaleConfig dataclass to configure YaRN RoPE scaling for long-context OLMO3 models
register_olmo_configs: register all OLMO2 and OLMO3 model configurations into a fairseq2 DependencyContainer
build_olmo2_32b_config: build an OLMO2 32B model config with GQA using 8 key-value heads and 64 layers
build_olmo3_7b_config: build an OLMO3 7B model config with hybrid sliding window attention and YaRN scaling
